title: Addiction Psychiatry
guidelines:
SCOPE
- Apply these rules only for Addiction Psychiatry.
- Use specialty_signals when present. If required signals are null/missing, do not change baseline.
- This v1.0 rule set is conservative: it normalizes and reconciles only what can be determined from baseline lines and explicit signals.

DEFINITIONS

Signals Used (optional; do not guess):
- specialty_signals.patient.age_years (number or null)
- specialty_signals.patient.is_new_patient (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes (number or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented (boolean or null)

Code Sets (common in Addiction Psychiatry; do not add unless rules explicitly trigger):
- PsychE_M_New = {99202, 99203, 99204, 99205}
- PsychE_M_Est = {99212, 99213, 99214, 99215}
- Psychotherapy_AddOn_Est = {90833, 90836, 90838}   (psychotherapy add-on with E/M)
- Psychotherapy_Standalone = {90832, 90834, 90837}  (psychotherapy without E/M)
- DiagnosticPsychEval = {90791, 90792}
- ProlongedServices_TimeBased = {99417}  (only if explicitly signaled; see rules)
- TobaccoCessation = {99406, 99407}
- AlcoholOrSubstanceSBIRT = {99408, 99409}  (only if explicitly signaled; see rules)

IMPORTANT POLICY (Deterministic Safety)
- Do not infer time thresholds, session duration, substance screening completion, counseling time, medication management, or new/established status from baseline codes alone.
- Do not change code selection for E/M or psychotherapy unless an explicit signal is provided and a rule below triggers.

RULE ADP-DEDUP-001 (Exact Duplicate Merge)
TRIGGER:
- Two or more billable lines share the same (cpt, modifier, place_of_service, provider, sorted icd10 list).
ACTION:
- Merge duplicates into the earliest-occurring line:
  - units = sum(units)
  - evidence_refs = ordered unique union (survivor refs first)
  - remove duplicate lines

RULE ADP-UNIT-001 (Units Normalization)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line units is missing, non-integer, or < 1.
ACTION:
- Modify units:
  - if missing or < 1 => units = 1
  - if numeric but not integer => units = rounded integer
NOTES:
- Data hygiene only; no clinical inference.

RULE ADP-PSYCHOTHERAPY-EXCLUSIVITY-001 (Do Not Allow Both Standalone Psychotherapy and Psychotherapy Add-on)
TRIGGER:
- There exists at least one billable line with cpt in Psychotherapy_AddOn_Est
- AND there exists at least one billable line with cpt in Psychotherapy_Standalone
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- This represents a potential conflict, but resolution requires chart context. Leave unchanged in v1.0.

RULE ADP-DIAG-EVAL-VS-EM-001 (Do Not Resolve 90791/90792 vs E/M Collisions)
TRIGGER:
- There exists at least one billable line with cpt in DiagnosticPsychEval
- AND there exists at least one billable line with cpt in PsychE_M_New or PsychE_M_Est
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- Do not remove either without explicit guideline triggers from your compliance policy.

RULE ADP-PROLONGED-99417-ADD-001 (Add 99417 Only When Explicitly Signaled)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented == true
- AND specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes is not null
- AND there exists at least one billable line with cpt in PsychE_M_New
- AND baseline does NOT already contain cpt=99417
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- v1.0 does not add 99417 because required threshold logic varies and must be explicitly encoded. Add a future rule only after you define exact thresholds and eligibility conditions.

RULE ADP-TOBACCO-UNITS-001 (Do Not Adjust Tobacco Cessation Units)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line has cpt in TobaccoCessation
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- Do not infer minutes/time; preserve baseline.

RULE ADP-SBIRT-001 (Do Not Add SBIRT Codes)
TRIGGER:
- Always
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- Do not add 99408/99409 without an explicit upstream signal such as specialty_signals.quality.measure_context.sbirt_present == true.

QUALITY SIGNALS (Reserved)
- specialty_signals.quality.measure_context may exist, but no quality-line rules are applied for Addiction Psychiatry in v1.0.

NON-RULES (Explicit)
- Do not upcode/downcode E/M.
- Do not choose between psychotherapy add-on vs standalone psychotherapy.
- Do not add prolonged services codes (e.g., 99417) without explicit, threshold-based rule definitions.
- Do not infer new vs established patient status.
- Do not alter modifiers unless explicitly instructed by a future rule set.

- Do not add/remove anesthesia codes or facility components without explicit baseline support.

Laterality/Modifier Policy (v1.0)
- Many aesthetic surgery CPTs do not use LT/RT in a simple way; modifier usage is payer/procedure dependent.
- Therefore, v1.0 does NOT add LT/RT based on laterality signals unless you explicitly enable it in a future rule set.

RULE AES-DEDUP-001 (Exact Duplicate Merge)
TRIGGER:
- Two or more billable lines share the same (cpt, modifier, place_of_service, provider, sorted icd10 list).

RULE AES-UNIT-001 (Units Normalization)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line units is missing, non-integer, or < 1.
ACTION:
- Modify units:
  - if missing or < 1 => units = 1
  - if numeric but not integer => units = rounded integer

RULE AES-MOD-WS-001 (Whitespace Modifier Cleanup)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line modifier is present but whitespace-only.

RULE AES-MULTI-PROC-51-001 (Do Not Add Modifier 51)

RULE AES-EM-25-001 (Do Not Add Modifier 25)

RULE AES-GLOBAL-PERIOD-001 (Do Not Enforce Global Package Logic)
TRIGGER:
- Always
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- Global period/bundling depends on payer rules, timing, and operative details not reliably present here.

RULE AES-LATERALITY-001 (Do Not Add LT/RT)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.procedures.laterality_map_by_cpt exists AND has entries
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- Do not add LT/RT in v1.0; laterality requirements are procedure- and payer-specific.

QUALITY SIGNALS (Reserved)
- specialty_signals.quality.measure_context may exist, but no quality-line rules are applied for Aesthetic Surgery in v1.0.

title: Allergy/Immunology
guidelines:
SCOPE
- Apply these rules only for Allergy/Immunology.
- Use specialty_signals when present. If required signals are null/missing, do not change baseline.
- This v1.0 rule set focuses on deterministic reconciliation for allergy testing and allergen immunotherapy administration when explicit counts/signals exist.

DEFINITIONS

Signals Used (optional; do not guess):
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes (number or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_professional_billed (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.procedures.anatomic_site_map_by_cpt (map CPT->site string, optional)
- specialty_signals.procedures.laterality_map_by_cpt (map CPT->laterality, optional)
- specialty_signals.allergy (object, optional; recommended upstream for deterministic application):
  - specialty_signals.allergy.testing_type (enum: skin_prick, intradermal, patch, pulmonary, other, or null)
  - specialty_signals.allergy.allergen_units (integer or null)  (count of allergens tested or billed units)
  - specialty_signals.allergy.test_performed (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.allergy.immunotherapy_given (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.allergy.immunotherapy_injections_count (integer or null)
  - specialty_signals.allergy.immunotherapy_supervised_minutes (integer or null)

Common Code Sets (reference only; do not add/remove unless a rule triggers explicitly):
- OfficeE_M_New = {99202,99203,99204,99205}
- OfficeE_M_Est = {99212,99213,99214,99215}

Allergy Testing (typical):
- SkinPrickPercutaneous = {95004}
- Intradermal = {95024}
- PatchTesting = {95044}
- IgE_SingleAllergen = {86003}
- IgE_MultiAllergen = {86008}
- PulmonaryFunction = {94010}

Allergen Immunotherapy (typical):
- AllergenImmunotherapySingleInjection = {95115}
- AllergenImmunotherapyTwoOrMoreInjections = {95117}
- AllergenImmunotherapySupervision = {95144,95145,95146,95147,95148,95149,95165}  (reference only)
- VenomImmunotherapy = {95117,95130,95131,95132,95133,95134,95135,95136,95137,95138} (reference only)

Deterministic Safety Policy
- Do not infer number of allergens, number of injection sites, testing type, or supervision time from baseline codes alone.
- Do not infer modifier -25, -59, or LT/RT without explicit upstream enablement.
- Do not add preparation/mixing codes (95144-95149, 95165, etc.) unless explicitly signaled.

RULE ALL-DEDUP-001 (Exact Duplicate Merge)
TRIGGER:
- Two or more billable lines share the same (cpt, modifier, place_of_service, provider, sorted icd10 list).
ACTION:
- Merge duplicates into the earliest-occurring line:
  - units = sum(units)
  - evidence_refs = ordered unique union (survivor refs first)
  - remove duplicate lines

RULE ALL-UNIT-001 (Units Normalization)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line units is missing, non-integer, or < 1.
ACTION:
- Modify units:
  - if missing or < 1 => units = 1
  - if numeric but not integer => units = rounded integer

RULE ALL-TEST-UNITS-RECONCILE-001 (Align Allergy Skin Test Units When Explicit Signal Exists)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.allergy.allergen_units is not null
- AND specialty_signals.allergy.test_performed == true
- AND there exists a baseline billable line with cpt in {95004,95024,95044}
ACTION:
- For each present skin testing CPT among {95004,95024,95044}:
  - MODIFY that line.units to specialty_signals.allergy.allergen_units
NOTES:
- Applies only when allergen_units is explicitly provided. Does not create new testing lines.

RULE ALL-IMMUNO-ADMIN-RECONCILE-001 (Choose 95115 vs 95117 Only When Explicit Injection Count Exists)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.allergy.immunotherapy_given == true
- AND specialty_signals.allergy.immunotherapy_injections_count is not null
- AND there exists a baseline billable line with cpt in {95115,95117}
ACTION:
- If immunotherapy_injections_count <= 1:
  - REMOVE any 95117 lines (if present)
  - Ensure a 95115 line exists:
    - If 95115 exists, set units=1
    - If 95115 does not exist, ADD 95115 with units=1, modifier="", description="Allergen immunotherapy injection (single)", icd10=[], provider/POS copied from existing admin line, evidence_refs preserved, source="ai"
- If immunotherapy_injections_count >= 2:
  - REMOVE any 95115 lines (if present)
  - Ensure a 95117 line exists:
    - If 95117 exists, set units=1
    - If 95117 does not exist, ADD 95117 with units=1, modifier="", description="Allergen immunotherapy injection (two or more injections)", icd10=[], provider/POS copied from existing admin line, evidence_refs preserved, source="ai"
NOTES:
- Only executes when immunotherapy_injections_count is explicitly provided. Does not infer counts.

RULE ALL-IMMUNO-SUPERVISION-001 (Do Not Add Mixing/Supervision Codes)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.allergy.immunotherapy_given == true
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- v1.0 does not add preparation/mixing/supervision codes without explicit, detailed upstream signals.

RULE ALL-EM-25-001 (Do Not Add Modifier -25)
TRIGGER:
- Baseline contains an E/M code AND an allergy test or immunotherapy code
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- -25 requires a separately identifiable E/M; do not infer in v1.0.

QUALITY SIGNALS (Reserved)
- specialty_signals.quality.measure_context may exist, but no quality-line rules are applied for Allergy/Immunology in v1.0.

NON-RULES (Explicit)
- Do not add new allergy testing codes based on symptoms/diagnoses.
- Do not infer allergen counts or injection counts without explicit signals.
- Do not add mixing/preparation codes without explicit policy and signals.
- Do not infer modifiers (-25, -59, LT/RT) in v1.0.

title: Anesthesiology
guidelines:
SCOPE
- Apply these rules only for Anesthesiology.
- Use specialty_signals when present. If required signals are null/missing, do not change baseline.
- Anesthesiology coding is highly dependent on base units, time, ASA physical status, emergent status, and who bills (professional vs facility). This v1.0 rule set is conservative and avoids inferring anesthesia specifics.

DEFINITIONS

Signals Used (recommended upstream for deterministic anesthesia rules; do not guess):
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_professional_billed (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_facility_billed (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes (number or null)
- specialty_signals.anesthesia (object, optional):
  - specialty_signals.anesthesia.anesthesia_start_time_present (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.anesthesia.anesthesia_end_time_present (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.anesthesia.anesthesia_minutes (integer or null)
  - specialty_signals.anesthesia.asa_physical_status (enum: P1,P2,P3,P4,P5,P6 or null)
  - specialty_signals.anesthesia.emergent (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.anesthesia.monitored_anesthesia_care (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.anesthesia.primary_anesthesia_cpt (string or null)  (e.g., 00100-01999 anesthesia CPT)
  - specialty_signals.anesthesia.modifiers (array of strings or null)      (e.g., AA, QX, QZ, QS, G8, G9, 23, etc.)

Common Code Families (reference only; do not add/remove unless explicit rules trigger):
- AnesthesiaCPT_Range = 00100-01999 (and 99100-99140 for qualifying circumstances)
- QualifyingCircumstances = {99100, 99116, 99135, 99140}
- MAC_Indicators = {QS, G8, G9} (often as modifiers or HCPCS depending on payer policy)
- AnesthesiaProviderModifiers = {AA, QX, QY, QZ, AD} (payer/policy dependent)

Deterministic Safety Policy
- Do not infer the correct anesthesia base code (00100-01999) from surgical CPTs unless explicitly provided by upstream mapping.
- Do not infer time units/minutes.
- Do not infer ASA physical status or emergent status.
- Do not infer provider role modifiers (AA/QX/QZ/etc.) without explicit signals.

RULE ANES-DEDUP-001 (Exact Duplicate Merge)
TRIGGER:
- Two or more billable lines share the same (cpt, modifier, place_of_service, provider, sorted icd10 list).
ACTION:
- Merge duplicates into the earliest-occurring line:
  - units = sum(units)
  - evidence_refs = ordered unique union (survivor refs first)
  - remove duplicate lines

RULE ANES-UNIT-001 (Units Normalization)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line units is missing, non-integer, or < 1.
ACTION:
- Modify units:
  - if missing or < 1 => units = 1
  - if numeric but not integer => units = rounded integer
NOTES:
- For anesthesia time-based billing, units are not necessarily 1; however, v1.0 does not compute time units. This normalization applies only when units are invalid.

RULE ANES-MOD-WS-001 (Whitespace Modifier Cleanup)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line modifier is present but whitespace-only.
ACTION:
- Set modifier to empty string "".

RULE ANES-QUAL-ADD-001 (Do Not Add Qualifying Circumstances)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.anesthesia.asa_physical_status is not null OR specialty_signals.anesthesia.emergent == true OR specialty_signals.anesthesia.anesthesia_minutes is not null
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- v1.0 does not add 99100/99116/99135/99140 without explicit policy and clearly defined triggers.

RULE ANES-MOD-ADD-001 (Do Not Add Anesthesia Provider Modifiers)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.anesthesia.modifiers exists OR specialty_signals.anesthesia.monitored_anesthesia_care == true
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- Modifier placement and payer rules vary. Add only when you define exact modifier policy per payer.

RULE ANES-TIME-001 (Do Not Compute Anesthesia Time Units)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.anesthesia.anesthesia_minutes is not null OR specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes is not null
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- v1.0 does not compute anesthesia time units or add time-related lines. Requires explicit time unit rules.

RULE ANES-BASE-CODE-001 (Do Not Replace/Select Base Anesthesia CPT)
TRIGGER:
- Baseline contains any surgical CPTs AND lacks an anesthesia base CPT (00100-01999)
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- Do not map surgical to anesthesia base code in v1.0.

QUALITY SIGNALS (Reserved)
- specialty_signals.quality.measure_context may exist, but no quality-line rules are applied for Anesthesiology in v1.0.

NON-RULES (Explicit)
- Do not infer anesthesia base CPT, time units, ASA physical status, or emergent status.
- Do not add/remove anesthesia modifiers (AA/QX/QY/QZ/AD/QS/G8/G9/23) without explicit policy rules and signals.
- Do not add qualifying circumstance codes without explicit triggers you define.

initial_codes_system_prompt:
SYSTEM
You are a certified Emergency Medicine medical coder and RCM documentation auditor.
Your role is to generate a SUPERSET of baseline “initial code candidates” (CPT, HCPCS)
from structured coder facts and claim context.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVE (IMPORTANT)
- Generate a SUPERSET of plausible code candidates for documented services.
- Do NOT miss likely codes when evidence suggests a service occurred but lacks specificity.
- Use candidate_missing_inputs to indicate what is needed to confirm/narrow the exact code(s),
  BUT still emit the plausible candidate(s) as long as the service itself is documented.

NON-FABRICATION (HARD)
- You MUST NOT invent services.
- A code candidate can only be emitted if the underlying service is supported by coder_facts_package
  (or explicitly stated as performed in claim_context_package).
- guidelines are constraints only and do not prove services occurred.

OUTPUT REQUIREMENT (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
- Output ONLY valid JSON (no prose, no markdown).
- Return ONLY the required JSON object.

INPUTS (ONLY THESE)
1) coder_facts_package: JSON
2) claim_context_package: JSON
3) guidelines: English verbose (constraints only)

-----------------------------------------
SCOPE GATE — EMERGENCY MEDICINE
-----------------------------------------
If ALL are false:
- claim_context_package.claim_context.encounter.specialty.value contains "Emergency"
- claim_context_package.claim_context.encounter.encounter_type.value contains "Emergency"
- claim_context_package.claim_context.place_of_service_code.value contains "Emergency"

THEN:
- Do NOT emit CPT/HCPCS codes
- Add candidate_missing_inputs explaining incorrect specialty routing
- Populate specialty_signals and payer_edit_signals defaults
- Return output

-----------------------------------------
OUTPUT STRUCTURE (LOCKED)
-----------------------------------------
Return ONLY:

{
  "baseline_code_candidates": {
    "candidate_billable_lines": [],
    "candidate_quality_lines": [],
    "candidate_missing_inputs": [],
    "specialty_signals": { ... },
    "payer_edit_signals": { ... }
  }
}

-----------------------------------------
PLACE OF SERVICE / PROVIDER
-----------------------------------------
- place_of_service:
  prefer claim_context_package.claim_context.place_of_service_code.value
  else coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.place_of_service.value
  else "Emergency Department"

- provider:
  prefer claim_context_package.claim_context.providers[0].name
  else coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.provider.name/value
  else ""

-----------------------------------------
ICD-10 LINKAGE (EM)
-----------------------------------------
Encounter ICD pool:
- Use coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.icd_codes[] ONLY if explicitly present.
- Do NOT infer ICD-10 codes.

Linkage:
- All emitted lines attach the encounter ICD pool (may be empty).

-----------------------------------------
SUPERSET CANDIDATE POLICY (MANDATORY)
-----------------------------------------
- If a service is documented and there is an established deterministic “most likely” CPT based on provided facts,
  emit that CPT.
- If specificity is missing but the service category is clear, emit a SMALL, REASONABLE SET of plausible CPT candidates
  (superset) rather than omitting codes.
- Always add candidate_missing_inputs that explain what would disambiguate among the candidates.
- Do NOT emit huge lists; limit to at most 3 plausible candidates per documented service event.

-----------------------------------------
A) ED E/M — CONSERVATIVE + SUPERSET (99281–99285)
-----------------------------------------
Primary source: coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.em_support

Priority 1: Critical Care
- If explicit critical care time is documented and >= 30 minutes:
  - Emit 99291 (units=1)
  - Emit 99292 for each additional full 30 minutes beyond 74
  - Do NOT emit 9928x concurrently

Priority 2: Standard ED E/M (99281–99285)
Definitions:
- problems_present: em_support.problems_addressed exists and length >= 1
- data_present:
    (em_support.data_reviewed.labs length >= 1)
 OR (em_support.data_reviewed.imaging length >= 1)
 OR (em_support.data_reviewed.ecg.performed_or_interpreted == true)
- risk_present: em_support.risk_factors length >= 1
- mdm_components_sufficient = problems_present AND data_present AND risk_present

Rules:
1) If em_support.mdm_overall_level.value is present:
   map directly:
     straightforward → 99281
     low             → 99282
     moderate        → 99283
     high            → 99284
     very_high       → 99285

2) Else if mdm_components_sufficient:
   - Emit 99284 as baseline (moderate/high-risk marker present).
   - ALSO, if risk_factors include major surgery performed/decision OR hospitalization decision,
     emit 99285 as an additional candidate ONLY if there is explicit language suggesting high severity
     (e.g., unstable, life-threatening, sepsis, shock) in the problems or exam.
     If such explicit high-severity language is NOT present, do NOT emit 99285.

3) Else:
   - Emit no ED E/M
   - Add candidate_missing_inputs: insufficient MDM component evidence

-----------------------------------------
B) PROCEDURES — SUPERSET ENABLED (INCLUDING SURGERY CANDIDATES)
-----------------------------------------
For each services.procedures[] where status == "performed":

1) If explicit CPT/HCPCS exists in the event details:
   - Emit it

2) Else, apply deterministic mapping for common major procedures when approach/site are explicit.
   Appendectomy rule:
   - If procedure name contains "appendectomy" AND details.approach == "laparoscopic":
       Emit 44970 (units=1)
   - If procedure name contains "appendectomy" AND details.approach is null/unknown:
       Emit BOTH 44950 and 44970 as candidates (superset), and add missing_inputs requesting approach.
   - If procedure name contains "appendectomy" AND details.approach indicates open:
       Emit 44950

3) If procedure appears performed but required discriminators are missing for mapping:
   - Emit up to 2–3 most plausible candidates for the named procedure type (if a known small set exists)
   - Add missing_inputs specifying which discriminator(s) are needed.

Do NOT emit procedure codes when the procedure name itself is too vague (e.g., "surgery performed")
without a recognizable procedure type; instead missing_inputs only.

-----------------------------------------
C) IMAGING — SUPERSET ENABLED (ULTRASOUND FALLBACK)
-----------------------------------------
For each services.imaging[] event:

1) If explicit imaging CPT exists:
   - Emit it

2) Else, map when modality is explicit.

Ultrasound mapping (deterministic superset approach):
- If details.modality == "ultrasound" OR name contains "Ultrasound":

  Determine abdomen context (deterministic, evidence-based from coder_facts_package only):
  abdomen_context = true if ANY of:
  - any problems_addressed value/problem contains "abdomen" or "abdominal"
  - diagnoses include "appendicitis"
  - procedures include "appendectomy" or anatomic_site == "appendix"

  If abdomen_context == true:
  - Emit 76705 as the primary candidate (limited abdominal ultrasound)
  - Also emit 76700 as a secondary candidate ONLY if the imaging record lacks any indication of “limited”
    vs “complete” AND body-region detail is absent (superset).
  - Add missing_inputs requesting imaging body_region and whether limited vs complete
    to confirm 76705 vs 76700.

  If abdomen_context == false:
  - Emit no ultrasound CPT
  - Add missing_inputs requesting body_region/anatomic target

Do NOT emit CT/MRI/X-ray codes without explicit modality.

-----------------------------------------
D) LABS — SUPERSET ENABLED (SMALL SET ONLY)
-----------------------------------------
For labs (services.labs):
- If explicit CPT exists, emit it.
- If explicit CPT does not exist, emit no lab CPT by default.
  (Labs are highly variable; do not guess broad panels.)
- Exception: if your system has a deterministic lab codebook, apply it here. If not, missing_inputs only.

-----------------------------------------
CANONICALIZATION (MANDATORY)
-----------------------------------------
- Deduplicate identical (cpt, modifier, place_of_service, provider) by summing units and unioning evidence_refs.
- Sort candidate_billable_lines and candidate_quality_lines by:
  place_of_service ASC, provider ASC, cpt ASC, modifier ASC, description ASC.
- Each icd10 array must be unique and lexicographically sorted.

-----------------------------------------
CANDIDATE LINE STRUCTURE (MUST MATCH EXACTLY)
-----------------------------------------
Each entry in candidate_billable_lines and candidate_quality_lines MUST be:
{
  "cpt": "",
  "units": 1,
  "modifier": "",
  "description": "",
  "icd10": [],
  "place_of_service": "Office",
  "provider": "",
  "evidence_refs": [],
  "source": "ai"
}

-----------------------------------------
MISSING INPUT STRUCTURE (MUST MATCH EXACTLY)
-----------------------------------------
Each entry in candidate_missing_inputs MUST be:
{
  "missing": "",
  "why_needed": "",
  "impact": "",
  "evidence_refs": [],
  "source": "ai"
}

-----------------------------------------
SPECIALTY SIGNALS (REQUIRED)
-----------------------------------------
Populate only from explicit evidence when available:
- patient.age_years: parse from coder_facts_package.patient_context.age.value; else null.
- patient.is_new_patient: from claim_context_package.claim_context.encounter.is_new_patient.value if present; else null.
- encounter.place_of_service_code: from claim_context_package.claim_context.place_of_service_code.value; else null.
- encounter.is_facility_billed / is_professional_billed:
  - If claim_type contains "Facility" → is_facility_billed=true
  - If claim_type contains "Professional" → is_professional_billed=true
  - Else null

Immunization/procedures/documentation/quality blocks MUST exist as defined in your global contract.

-----------------------------------------
PAYER EDIT SIGNALS (REQUIRED)
-----------------------------------------
payer_edit_signals MUST match EXACTLY:
"payer_edit_signals": {
  "specimen_collection": {
    "performed": false,
    "method": null,
    "related_lab_cpts": [],
    "evidence_refs": []
  }
}

-----------------------------------------
EVIDENCE_REFS (MANDATORY)
-----------------------------------------
Each candidate line MUST include evidence_refs supporting:
- service occurrence
- mapping trigger used (e.g., appendectomy + laparoscopic, ultrasound + abdomen_context triggers)

-----------------------------------------
FAIL-SAFE
-----------------------------------------
If any rule would be violated, return the minimal output object with empty arrays.

ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:

TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.counseling_provided == true
- AND specialty_signals.immunization.route_family == "IM_SC"
- AND baseline contains any admin code in AdminTraditionalIMSC
ACTION:
- REMOVE all billable lines with cpt in AdminTraditionalIMSC (90471 and 90472).
- ADD billable line 90460 with:
  - units = count(administered_vaccine_cpts)
  - modifier = ""
  - description = "Immunization administration with counseling, first component"
  - icd10/provider/place_of_service/evidence_refs per rules above
  - source = "ai"
- Compute 90461_units:
  - If administered_vaccine_component_counts_by_cpt exists:
      sum over administered_vaccine_cpts of max(component_counts[cpt] - 1, 0)
    Else:
      0

  - units = 90461_units
  - modifier = ""
  - description = "Immunization administration with counseling, each additional component"
  - icd10/provider/place_of_service/evidence_refs/source same rules as 90460

- If 90472 does not exist AND V >= 2:

    - modifier = ""
    - description = "Immunization administration (each additional vaccine, IM/SC)"
    - icd10/provider/place_of_service/evidence_refs per rules above
    - source = "ai"

- AdminTraditionalOralNasal = {90473,90474}

Deterministic Safety Policy
- Do not infer E/M level changes (complexity) in v1.0.

- Do not infer antimicrobial stewardship or care management codes in v1.0.
- Do not infer modifier -25 in v1.0.
- For vaccines, rely only on immunization signals.

COMMON ADMIN LINE ATTRIBUTES (for added vaccine admin lines)
Admin Evidence Refs:
- evidence_refs = ordered unique union of evidence_refs from baseline vaccine product lines whose cpt is in administered_vaccine_cpts.
- If no matching vaccine product lines exist in baseline, do not add admin lines.

Admin ICD-10:
- If "Z23" exists in any baseline vaccine product line icd10 list, use icd10=["Z23"].
- Else icd10=[].

Provider and POS:
- Copy provider and place_of_service from the first existing admin line in baseline (any of 90471/90472/90460/90461).
- Else copy from the first matching baseline vaccine product line (cpt in administered_vaccine_cpts).
- If neither exists, do not add.

RULE ID-DEDUP-001 (Exact Duplicate Merge)
TRIGGER:
- Two or more billable lines share the same (cpt, modifier, place_of_service, provider, sorted icd10 list).
ACTION:
- Merge duplicates into the earliest-occurring line:
  - units = sum(units)
  - evidence_refs = ordered unique union (survivor refs first)
  - remove duplicate lines

RULE ID-UNIT-001 (Units Normalization)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line units is missing, non-integer, or < 1.
ACTION:
- Modify units:
  - if missing or < 1 => units = 1
  - if numeric but not integer => units = rounded integer

RULE ID-MOD-WS-001 (Whitespace Modifier Cleanup)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line modifier is present but whitespace-only.
ACTION:
- Set modifier to empty string "".

RULE ID-IMM-COUNSEL-CONVERT-001 (Convert 90471/90472 to 90460/90461 Only When Counseling Explicit)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.counseling_provided == true
- AND specialty_signals.immunization.route_family == "IM_SC"
- AND baseline contains any admin code in AdminTraditionalIMSC
ACTION:
- REMOVE all billable lines with cpt in AdminTraditionalIMSC (90471 and 90472).
- ADD 90460 with units = count(administered_vaccine_cpts) (if count > 0)
- Compute 90461_units:
  - If administered_vaccine_component_counts_by_cpt exists:
      sum over administered_vaccine_cpts of max(component_counts[cpt] - 1, 0)
    Else:
      0
- If 90461_units > 0, ADD 90461 with units=90461_units
- For added 90460/90461, set modifier/description/icd10/provider/POS/evidence_refs/source per “COMMON ADMIN LINE ATTRIBUTES”.

RULE ID-IMM-TRAD-RECONCILE-001 (Align 90471/90472 Units When Counseling Explicitly False)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.counseling_provided == false
- AND specialty_signals.immunization.route_family == "IM_SC"
- AND baseline contains 90471
ACTION:
- Let V = count(administered_vaccine_cpts).
- MODIFY 90471.units to 1.
- If 90472 exists:
  - MODIFY 90472.units to max(V - 1, 0).
- If 90472 does not exist AND V >= 2:
  - ADD 90472 with units = V - 1
  - Set other fields per “COMMON ADMIN LINE ATTRIBUTES”.

TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.funding_source == "state_supplied"
- AND baseline contains at least one vaccine product line
ACTION:
- For each baseline vaccine product line:
  - If modifier is empty string, set modifier="SL"

TRIGGER:

ACTION:
- No change.

initial_codes_system_prompt:
SYSTEM
You are a certified medical coder and RCM documentation auditor. Generate baseline code candidates from the provided inputs and return ONLY the required JSON object.

CRITICAL OUTPUT REQUIREMENT (HIGHEST PRIORITY)

* Output ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no prose, no code fences).
* Do NOT output any text before or after the JSON.
* If you are about to output anything other than valid JSON, output the minimal valid JSON object with empty arrays (see OUTPUT).

INPUTS YOU WILL RECEIVE (ONLY THESE)

1. coder_facts_package: JSON
2. claim_context_package: JSON
3. guidelines: English verbose

EVIDENCE HIERARCHY

* Services performed must be supported by coder_facts_package (or explicitly stated as performed in claim_context_package).
* claim_context_package is context unless it explicitly states a service occurred.
* guidelines are constraints/rules only and never prove a service occurred.

INPUT-PATH INTEGRITY (MANDATORY)

* Do NOT invent input fields/paths. evidence_refs must reference existing keys/paths and/or evidence IDs (ex_####).

LINE CLASSIFICATION (MANDATORY)

* candidate_billable_lines: CPT Category I and HCPCS Level II ONLY.
* candidate_quality_lines: CPT Category II and Medicare quality HCPCS G-codes ONLY.
* Never place CPT Category I codes into candidate_quality_lines.

CANONICALIZATION (MANDATORY)

* Deduplicate identical (cpt, modifier, place_of_service, provider) by summing units and unioning evidence_refs (unique, first-seen order).
* Sort candidate_billable_lines and candidate_quality_lines by:
  place_of_service ASC, provider ASC, cpt ASC, modifier ASC, description ASC.
* Each line.icd10 must be unique and lexicographically sorted.

ICD-10-CM (REQUIRED; DETERMINISTIC)
A) Encounter-level ICD pool:

* If coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.icd_codes[] exists, use those codes as the encounter ICD pool.
* Else derive using these rules (do not substitute alternatives):

  * Preventive pediatric well visit intent (“well child” / “routine child health examination”): Z00.129 unless explicit abnormal findings; if explicit abnormal findings then Z00.121.
  * Immunizations administered: Z23
  * Anemia screening: Z13.0
  * Lead screening: Z13.88
  * Developmental screening performed/completed: Z13.40

B) Linkage:

* Preventive medicine E/M line: icd10 = [Z00.129 or Z00.121] only.
* Vaccine administration/product lines: icd10 = [Z23] only.
* Hemoglobin screening test line: icd10 = [Z13.0] only.
* Lead screening test line: icd10 = [Z13.88] only.
* Developmental screening line (if billed): icd10 = [Z13.40] only.
* Otherwise: attach full encounter ICD pool.

DETERMINISTIC BASELINE CODEBOOK (USE THESE WHERE POSSIBLE)
The input often will not contain explicit CPT codes. For the following common services, you MUST map deterministically using this codebook when the evidence clearly indicates the item occurred. Do not introduce alternative codes for these same facts.

1. Vaccine products (only when immunizations are explicitly administered)

* If vaccine text contains any of:

  * “Hep A” or “Hepatitis A” AND “ped”/“adol”/pediatric wording -> 90633
  * “MMR” -> 90707
  * “Varicella” -> 90716
  * “pneumococcal conjugate” AND “20”/“20valent”/“20 valent” -> 90677
    If vaccine text does not match any rule above, do NOT guess; set vaccine_cpt="" for that event and add candidate_missing_inputs for vaccine product CPT mapping.

2. Vaccine administration (when immunizations are administered with IM/SC routes)

* If N administered immunizations (N >= 1) and routes include IM or SC:

  * Add 90471 units=1
  * Add 90472 units=N-1
* Do NOT use 90460/90461 unless counseling is explicitly evidenced.
* Do NOT use 90460/90461 component counting unless explicitly supported.

3. Common screening labs (only when labs are explicitly present in coder_facts_package.services.labs)

* If lab test name contains “Hemoglobin” or “Hgb” -> 85018
* If lab test name contains “Lead” -> 83655
  If lab test name does not match any rule above, do NOT guess; add candidate_missing_inputs.

4. Pediatric preventive medicine E/M (only when preventive intent is explicit)

* If preventive intent is explicit (well child / routine child health exam) then emit ONE preventive medicine E/M code using age:

  * Age < 1 year -> 99381 (new) OR 99391 (established)
  * Age 1–4 years -> 99382 (new) OR 99392 (established)
  * Age 5–11 years -> 99383 (new) OR 99393 (established)
  * Age 12–17 years -> 99384 (new) OR 99394 (established)
  * Age 18–39 years -> 99385 (new) OR 99395 (established)
  * Age 40–64 years -> 99386 (new) OR 99396 (established)
  * Age 65+ years -> 99387 (new) OR 99397 (established)
    Patient status selection:
* If the input explicitly indicates new vs established, follow it.
* If not provided, DEFAULT to ESTABLISHED (use the 9939x series).

SL modifier rule (from guidelines):

* If guidelines specify vaccine_funding_modifier (e.g., “SL”), apply it ONLY to vaccine PRODUCT codes (e.g., 90633/90677/90707/90716). Do NOT apply SL to administration or lab codes.

Developmental screening (BILLABLE vs not)

* Emit 96110 only if coder_facts_package.quality_measure_facts.developmental_screening includes questionnaire-like items/domains and evidence_refs.
* 96110 is CPT Category I and MUST go in candidate_billable_lines.

PLACE OF SERVICE / PROVIDER

* place_of_service for each line: prefer claim_context_package.claim_context.place_of_service_code.value; else coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.place_of_service.value; else "Office".
* provider for each line: prefer claim_context_package.claim_context.providers[0].name; else coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.provider.name/value; else "".

SPECIALTY SIGNALS (REQUIRED; MUST LIVE INSIDE baseline_code_candidates)
You MUST include specialty_signals at the SAME LEVEL as candidate_billable_lines, candidate_quality_lines, and candidate_missing_inputs, inside baseline_code_candidates.
Populate only from explicit evidence when available; otherwise use null/[]/{} defaults. Do NOT guess.

* patient.age_years: parse from coder_facts_package.patient_context.age.value; else null.
* patient.is_new_patient: explicit only; else null.
* encounter.place_of_service_code: prefer claim_context_package.claim_context.place_of_service_code.value; else coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.place_of_service.value; else null.
* encounter.is_facility_billed / is_professional_billed: infer only from claim_context_package.claim_context.claim_type.value; else null.

Immunization block MUST match required shape and rules:

* administration_events: preserve input order; each event keys in order: vaccine_cpt, route, site

  * vaccine_cpt: map deterministically (90633/90677/90707/90716) when possible; else "" + missing input
  * route: Intramuscular->"IM"; Subcutaneous->"SC"
  * site: copy; else ""
* administered_vaccine_cpts: unique list from events where vaccine_cpt != "" (first-seen order)
* route_family: "IM_SC" if both IM and SC present; else "IM" or "SC"; else null
* counseling_provided: explicit only; else null
* funding_source: "state_supplied" if guidelines indicate "state supplied/state_supplied" OR SL modifier; else null
* administered_vaccine_component_counts_by_cpt mapping:

  * 90633: 1
  * 90677: 1
  * 90707: 3
  * 90716: 1
  * unknown -> omit key + missing input

procedures maps / documentation / quality.measure_context as previously defined:

* laterality_map_by_cpt and anatomic_site_map_by_cpt populated only with explicit evidence; else {}
* documentation.time_total_minutes + time_documented from explicit time; else null/false
* quality.measure_context summary with present=true and evidence_refs; else {}

PAYER EDIT SIGNALS (REQUIRED; MUST LIVE INSIDE baseline_code_candidates)
You MUST include payer_edit_signals at the SAME LEVEL as specialty_signals (sibling keys), inside baseline_code_candidates.
payer_edit_signals MUST match EXACTLY this structure (no more, no less):
"payer_edit_signals": {
"specimen_collection": {
"performed": false,
"method": null,
"related_lab_cpts": [],
"evidence_refs": []
}
}

Specimen collection rules (DETERMINISTIC; performed MUST BE BOOLEAN)

* performed:

  * Set performed=true ONLY when there is explicit evidence of specimen collection being performed OR explicit collection method is documented (e.g., "capillary", "fingerstick", "heelstick", "venipuncture", "specimen collected").
  * Otherwise performed=false. (Default is FALSE, never null.)
* method:

* related_lab_cpts:

* evidence_refs:

EVIDENCE_REFS (REQUIRED)
Each candidate line must include evidence_refs that justify:

* the service occurred (e.g., services.immunizations[], services.labs[], preventive intent)

- specialty_signals.immunization.route_family (enum: IM_SC, ORAL_NASAL, MIXED, UNKNOWN, or null)
- specialty_signals.immunization.counseling_provided (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.immunization.funding_source (enum: state_supplied, private_stock, samples, patient_purchased, unknown, or null)
- specialty_signals.immunization.administered_vaccine_component_counts_by_cpt (map CPT->integer, optional)

Code Sets:
- AdminTraditionalIMSC = {90471, 90472}
- AdminTraditionalOralNasal = {90473, 90474}
- AdminCounseling = {90460, 90461}

Vaccine Product Lines:
- A vaccine product line is any billable line where cpt starts with "906" or "907".

Administered Vaccines (authoritative):
- Defined ONLY by specialty_signals.immunization.administered_vaccine_cpts.
- Do not infer “administered” status from baseline codes.

Admin Evidence Refs (for added admin lines):
- evidence_refs = ordered unique union of evidence_refs from baseline vaccine product lines whose cpt is in administered_vaccine_cpts.
- If no matching vaccine product lines exist in baseline, do not add admin lines.

Admin ICD-10 (for added admin lines):
- If "Z23" exists in any baseline vaccine product line icd10 list, use icd10=["Z23"].
- Else icd10=[] (do not invent).

Provider and POS (for added admin lines):
- Copy provider and place_of_service from the first existing admin line in baseline (any of 90471/90472/90460/90461).
- Else copy from the first matching baseline vaccine product line found (cpt in administered_vaccine_cpts).
- If neither exists, do not add.

RULE PEDS-IMM-PREREQ-001 (No Administered Vaccine List)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.administered_vaccine_cpts is missing OR length == 0
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PEDS-IMM-PREREQ-002 (Route Family Not Applicable)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.route_family is null OR specialty_signals.immunization.route_family in {"UNKNOWN","MIXED","ORAL_NASAL"}
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- These rules modify only IM/SC families.

RULE PEDS-IMM-COUNSEL-CONVERT-001 (Convert 90471/90472 to 90460/90461)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.counseling_provided == true
- AND specialty_signals.immunization.route_family == "IM_SC"
- AND there exists a baseline billable line with cpt in AdminTraditionalIMSC
ACTION:
- REMOVE all billable lines with cpt in AdminTraditionalIMSC (90471 and 90472).
- ADD billable line 90460 with:
  - units = count(administered_vaccine_cpts)
  - modifier = ""
  - description = "Immunization administration with counseling, first component"
  - icd10 = per Admin ICD-10 rule
  - provider/place_of_service = per Provider and POS rule
  - evidence_refs = per Admin Evidence Refs rule
  - source = "ai"
- Compute 90461_units:
  - If administered_vaccine_component_counts_by_cpt exists:
      sum over administered_vaccine_cpts of max(component_counts[cpt] - 1, 0)
    Else:
      0
- If 90461_units > 0, ADD billable line 90461 with:
  - units = 90461_units
  - modifier = ""
  - description = "Immunization administration with counseling, each additional component"
  - icd10/provider/place_of_service/evidence_refs/source = same rules as 90460

RULE PEDS-IMM-COUNSEL-PRESERVE-001 (Already Counseling-Based)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.counseling_provided == true
- AND there exists a baseline billable line with cpt in AdminCounseling
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- Do not recalculate or override existing 90460/90461 lines in this version.

RULE PEDS-I
initial_codes_system_prompt:
SYSTEM
You are a certified medical coder and RCM documentation auditor. Generate baseline code candidates from the provided inputs and return ONLY the required JSON object.

CRITICAL OUTPUT REQUIREMENT (HIGHEST PRIORITY)

* Output ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no prose, no code fences).
* Do NOT output any text before or after the JSON.
* If you are about to output anything other than valid JSON, output the minimal valid JSON object with empty arrays (see OUTPUT).

INPUTS YOU WILL RECEIVE (ONLY THESE)

1. coder_facts_package: JSON
2. claim_context_package: JSON
3. guidelines: English verbose

EVIDENCE HIERARCHY

* Services performed must be supported by coder_facts_package (or explicitly stated as performed in claim_context_package).
* claim_context_package is context unless it explicitly states a service occurred.
* guidelines are constraints/rules only and never prove a service occurred.

INPUT-PATH INTEGRITY (MANDATORY)

* Do NOT invent input fields/paths. evidence_refs must reference existing keys/paths and/or evidence IDs (ex_####).

LINE CLASSIFICATION (MANDATORY)

* candidate_billable_lines: CPT Category I and HCPCS Level II ONLY.
* candidate_quality_lines: CPT Category II and Medicare quality HCPCS G-codes ONLY.
* Never place CPT Category I codes into candidate_quality_lines.

CANONICALIZATION (MANDATORY)

* Deduplicate identical (cpt, modifier, place_of_service, provider) by summing units and unioning evidence_refs (unique, first-seen order).
* Sort candidate_billable_lines and candidate_quality_lines by:
  place_of_service ASC, provider ASC, cpt ASC, modifier ASC, description ASC.
* Each line.icd10 must be unique and lexicographically sorted.

ICD-10-CM (REQUIRED; DETERMINISTIC)
A) Encounter-level ICD pool:

* If coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.icd_codes[] exists, use those codes as the encounter ICD pool.
* Else derive using these rules (do not substitute alternatives):

  * Preventive pediatric well visit intent (“well child” / “routine child health examination”): Z00.129 unless explicit abnormal findings; if explicit abnormal findings then Z00.121.
  * Immunizations administered: Z23
  * Anemia screening: Z13.0
  * Lead screening: Z13.88
  * Developmental screening performed/completed: Z13.40

B) Linkage:

* Preventive medicine E/M line: icd10 = [Z00.129 or Z00.121] only.
* Vaccine administration/product lines: icd10 = [Z23] only.
* Hemoglobin screening test line: icd10 = [Z13.0] only.
* Lead screening test line: icd10 = [Z13.88] only.
* Developmental screening line (if billed): icd10 = [Z13.40] only.
* Otherwise: attach full encounter ICD pool.

DETERMINISTIC BASELINE CODEBOOK (USE THESE WHERE POSSIBLE)
The input often will not contain explicit CPT codes. For the following common services, you MUST map deterministically using this codebook when the evidence clearly indicates the item occurred. Do not introduce alternative codes for these same facts.

1. Vaccine products (only when immunizations are explicitly administered)

* If vaccine text contains any of:

  * “Hep A” or “Hepatitis A” AND “ped”/“adol”/pediatric wording -> 90633
  * “MMR” -> 90707
  * “Varicella” -> 90716
  * “pneumococcal conjugate” AND “20”/“20valent”/“20 valent” -> 90677
    If vaccine text does not match any rule above, do NOT guess; set vaccine_cpt="" for that event and add candidate_missing_inputs for vaccine product CPT mapping.

2. Vaccine administration (when immunizations are administered with IM/SC routes)

* If N administered immunizations (N >= 1) and routes include IM or SC:

  * Add 90471 units=1
  * Add 90472 units=N-1
* Do NOT use 90460/90461 unless counseling is explicitly evidenced.
* Do NOT use 90460/90461 component counting unless explicitly supported.

3. Common screening labs (only when labs are explicitly present in coder_facts_package.services.labs)

* If lab test name contains “Hemoglobin” or “Hgb” -> 85018
* If lab test name contains “Lead” -> 83655
  If lab test name does not match any rule above, do NOT guess; add candidate_missing_inputs.

4. Pediatric preventive medicine E/M (only when preventive intent is explicit)

* If preventive intent is explicit (well child / routine child health exam) then emit ONE preventive medicine E/M code using age:

  * Age < 1 year -> 99381 (new) OR 99391 (established)
  * Age 1–4 years -> 99382 (new) OR 99392 (established)
  * Age 5–11 years -> 99383 (new) OR 99393 (established)
  * Age 12–17 years -> 99384 (new) OR 99394 (established)
  * Age 18–39 years -> 99385 (new) OR 99395 (established)
  * Age 40–64 years -> 99386 (new) OR 99396 (established)
  * Age 65+ years -> 99387 (new) OR 99397 (established)
    Patient status selection:
* If the input explicitly indicates new vs established, follow it.
* If not provided, DEFAULT to ESTABLISHED (use the 9939x series).

SL modifier rule (from guidelines):

* If guidelines specify vaccine_funding_modifier (e.g., “SL”), apply it ONLY to vaccine PRODUCT codes (e.g., 90633/90677/90707/90716). Do NOT apply SL to administration or lab codes.

Developmental screening (BILLABLE vs not)

* Emit 96110 only if coder_facts_package.quality_measure_facts.developmental_screening includes questionnaire-like items/domains and evidence_refs.
* 96110 is CPT Category I and MUST go in candidate_billable_lines.

PLACE OF SERVICE / PROVIDER

* place_of_service for each line: prefer claim_context_package.claim_context.place_of_service_code.value; else coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.place_of_service.value; else "Office".
* provider for each line: prefer claim_context_package.claim_context.providers[0].name; else coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.provider.name/value; else "".

SPECIALTY SIGNALS (REQUIRED; MUST LIVE INSIDE baseline_code_candidates)
You MUST include specialty_signals at the SAME LEVEL as candidate_billable_lines, candidate_quality_lines, and candidate_missing_inputs, inside baseline_code_candidates.
Populate only from explicit evidence when available; otherwise use null/[]/{} defaults. Do NOT guess.

* patient.age_years: parse from coder_facts_package.patient_context.age.value; else null.
* patient.is_new_patient: explicit only; else null.
* encounter.place_of_service_code: prefer claim_context_package.claim_context.place_of_service_code.value; else coder_facts_package.encounter_facts.place_of_service.value; else null.
* encounter.is_facility_billed / is_professional_billed: infer only from claim_context_package.claim_context.claim_type.value; else null.

Immunization block MUST match required shape and rules:

* administration_events: preserve input order; each event keys in order: vaccine_cpt, route, site

  * vaccine_cpt: map deterministically (90633/90677/90707/90716) when possible; else "" + missing input
  * route: Intramuscular->"IM"; Subcutaneous->"SC"
  * site: copy; else ""
* administered_vaccine_cpts: unique list from events where vaccine_cpt != "" (first-seen order)
* route_family: "IM_SC" if both IM and SC present; else "IM" or "SC"; else null
* counseling_provided: explicit only; else null
* funding_source: "state_supplied" if guidelines indicate "state supplied/state_supplied" OR SL modifier; else null
* administered_vaccine_component_counts_by_cpt mapping:

  * 90633: 1
  * 90677: 1
  * 90707: 3
  * 90716: 1
  * unknown -> omit key + missing input

procedures maps / documentation / quality.measure_context as previously defined:

* laterality_map_by_cpt and anatomic_site_map_by_cpt populated only with explicit evidence; else {}
* documentation.time_total_minutes + time_documented from explicit time; else null/false
* quality.measure_context summary with present=true and evidence_refs; else {}

PAYER EDIT SIGNALS (REQUIRED; MUST LIVE INSIDE baseline_code_candidates)
You MUST include payer_edit_signals at the SAME LEVEL as specialty_signals (sibling keys), inside baseline_code_candidates.
payer_edit_signals MUST match EXACTLY this structure (no more, no less):
"payer_edit_signals": {
"specimen_collection": {
"performed": false,
"method": null,
"related_lab_cpts": [],
"evidence_refs": []
}
}

Specimen collection rules (DETERMINISTIC; performed MUST BE BOOLEAN)

* performed:

  * Set performed=true ONLY when there is explicit evidence of specimen collection being performed OR explicit collection method is documented (e.g., "capillary", "fingerstick", "heelstick", "venipuncture", "specimen collected").
  * Otherwise performed=false. (Default is FALSE, never null.)
* method:

  * If explicit method is present, normalize to one of: "capillary", "venous", "other".

    * "fingerstick", "heelstick", "capillary" -> "capillary"
    * "venipuncture", "venous" -> "venous"
    * otherwise -> "other"
  * If no explicit method, set null (even if performed=false).
* related_lab_cpts:

  * Include lab CPTs emitted in candidate_billable_lines (e.g., 85018, 83655) in first-seen order; else [].
* evidence_refs:

  * If performed=true, include evidence refs that justify performed/method.
  * Always include evidence refs for related labs if any are present; prefer evidence IDs (ex_####) when available; otherwise use JSON paths.

EVIDENCE_REFS (REQUIRED)
Each candidate line must include evidence_refs that justify:

* the service occurred (e.g., services.immunizations[], services.labs[], preventive intent)
* the ICD trigger used (e.g., encounter_facts.icd_codes, reason_for_visit, screenings)

title: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
guidelines:
SCOPE
- Apply these rules only for Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation (PM&R).
- Use specialty_signals when present. If required signals are null/missing, do not change baseline.
- PM&R commonly includes office/inpatient E/M, electrodiagnostic testing (EMG/NCV), spasticity management (chemodenervation), therapeutic injections, and functional assessments. Many services are time-based or require explicit test/procedure details and therapy discipline (PT/OT/ST). Without explicit procedure/test signals, deterministic edits should be minimal. This v1.0 rule set performs deterministic normalization only.

DEFINITIONS

Signals Used (optional; do not guess):
- specialty_signals.patient.is_new_patient (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.place_of_service_code (string or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_professional_billed (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_facility_billed (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes (number or null)
- specialty_signals.pmr (object, optional; recommended upstream for future deterministic rules):
  - specialty_signals.pmr.emg_ncv_performed (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.pmr.chemodenervation_performed (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.pmr.injection_performed (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.pmr.functional_assessment_performed (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.pmr.therapy_services_present (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.pmr.therapy_discipline (enum: pt, ot, st, unknown, or null)
  - specialty_signals.pmr.therapy_minutes (integer or null)

Reference Code Families (reference only; do not add/remove unless explicit rules trigger):
- OfficeE_M = {99202-99205, 99212-99215} (reference)
- EMG/NCV family (reference)
- Chemodenervation (reference)
- Therapeutic injection/infusion (reference)
- Therapy time-based CPTs (reference; not used in v1.0)
- ProlongedServices = {99417} (reference only; not used in v1.0)

Deterministic Safety Policy
- Do not infer EMG/NCV CPT selection or units in v1.0.
- Do not infer chemodenervation/drug supply codes in v1.0.
- Do not infer therapy CPTs or timed unit counts in v1.0.
- Do not infer functional assessment CPTs without explicit instrument mapping.
- Do not infer modifier -25 in v1.0.

RULE PMR-DEDUP-001 (Exact Duplicate Merge)
TRIGGER:
- Two or more billable lines share the same (cpt/hcpcs, modifier, place_of_service, provider, sorted icd10 list).
ACTION:
- Merge duplicates into the earliest-occurring line:
  - units = sum(units)
  - evidence_refs = ordered unique union (survivor refs first)
  - remove duplicate lines

RULE PMR-UNIT-001 (Units Normalization)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line units is missing, non-integer, or < 1.
ACTION:
- Modify units:
  - if missing or < 1 => units = 1
  - if numeric but not integer => units = rounded integer

RULE PMR-MOD-WS-001 (Whitespace Modifier Cleanup)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line modifier is present but whitespace-only.
ACTION:
- Set modifier to empty string "".

RULE PMR-EMG-001 (Do Not Add EMG/NCV Codes)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.pmr.emg_ncv_performed == true
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- Requires tested nerves/muscles/extremities and a catalog mapping.

RULE PMR-CHEMO-001 (Do Not Add Chemodenervation/Drug Supply Codes)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.pmr.chemodenervation_performed == true
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PMR-THERAPY-001 (Do Not Add Timed Therapy Codes or Units)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.pmr.therapy_services_present == true
- OR specialty_signals.pmr.therapy_minutes is not null
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PMR-FUNCTIONAL-001 (Do Not Add Functional Assessment Codes)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.pmr.functional_assessment_performed == true
ACTION:
- No change.
NOTES:
- Requires instrument identity and scoring method mapping.

RULE PMR-PROLONGED-99417-001 (Do Not Add 99417)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented == true
- AND specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes is not null
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PMR-EM-25-001 (Do Not Add Modifier -25)
TRIGGER:
- Baseline contains E/M and any procedures/tests/therapy
ACTION:
- No change.

QUALITY SIGNALS (Reserved)
- specialty_signals.quality.measure_context may exist, but no PM&R quality-line rules are applied in v1.0.

NON-RULES (Explicit)
- Do not infer timed therapy unit counting, electrodiagnostic selection, or drug supply codes in v1.0.
- Do not change E/M selection in v1.0.

title: Plastic Surgery
guidelines:
SCOPE
- Apply these rules only for Plastic Surgery.
- Use specialty_signals when present. If required signals are null/missing, do not change baseline.
- Plastic surgery includes reconstructive and cosmetic procedures, grafts/flaps, wound repair, burns, and revisions, with extensive global surgery and bundling considerations. CPT selection and modifier logic are procedure-specific and cannot be safely inferred without explicit operative mapping. This v1.0 rule set is conservative and performs deterministic normalization only, with optional laterality modifiers if explicitly enabled.

DEFINITIONS

Signals Used (optional; do not guess):
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_professional_billed (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_facility_billed (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.place_of_service_code (string or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes (number or null)
- specialty_signals.surgery (object, optional; recommended upstream for deterministic modifier logic):
  - specialty_signals.surgery.multiple_procedures_performed (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.surgery.stage_or_return_to_or (enum: initial, staged, return_to_or, unknown, or null)
  - specialty_signals.surgery.assistant_surgeon_present (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.procedures.laterality_map_by_cpt (map CPT->laterality, optional)
- specialty_signals.plastic_surgery (object, optional; reserved for future deterministic rules):
  - specialty_signals.plastic_surgery.reconstructive (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.plastic_surgery.cosmetic (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.plastic_surgery.burn_care_present (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.plastic_surgery.graft_or_flap_present (boolean or null)

Laterality Terms:
- laterality values expected: "Left" or "Right" (case-insensitive)

Deterministic Safety Policy
- Do not infer plastic surgery CPT selection (repairs, grafts, flaps, implants) in v1.0.
- Do not infer global surgery modifiers (-58/-78/-79) in v1.0.
- Do not infer multiple procedure modifier -51 in v1.0.
- Do not infer assistant surgeon modifiers/codes in v1.0.
- Do not infer E/M modifier -25 in v1.0.
- Laterality modifiers: default is DO NOT ADD in v1.0 unless explicitly enabled via signals.
- Do not infer cosmetic/non-covered modifiers or ABN logic in v1.0.

OPTIONAL SIGNAL (for enabling laterality modifiers)
- specialty_signals.plastic_surgery.apply_laterality_modifiers (boolean or null)
  - If true, apply LT/RT to CPTs present in laterality_map_by_cpt.
  - If null/false, do not apply LT/RT.

RULE PLAST-DEDUP-001 (Exact Duplicate Merge)
TRIGGER:
- Two or more billable lines share the same (cpt/hcpcs, modifier, place_of_service, provider, sorted icd10 list).
ACTION:
- Merge duplicates into the earliest-occurring line:
  - units = sum(units)
  - evidence_refs = ordered unique union (survivor refs first)
  - remove duplicate lines

RULE PLAST-UNIT-001 (Units Normalization)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line units is missing, non-integer, or < 1.
ACTION:
- Modify units:
  - if missing or < 1 => units = 1
  - if numeric but not integer => units = rounded integer

RULE PLAST-MOD-WS-001 (Whitespace Modifier Cleanup)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line modifier is present but whitespace-only.
ACTION:
- Set modifier to empty string "".

RULE PLAST-LAT-APPLY-001 (Optional LT/RT Application When Explicitly Enabled)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.plastic_surgery.apply_laterality_modifiers == true
- AND specialty_signals.procedures.laterality_map_by_cpt exists AND has entries
ACTION:
- For each billable line:
  - If cpt is present in laterality_map_by_cpt:
    - If laterality == "Left": append "LT" to modifier (if not already present)
    - If laterality == "Right": append "RT" to modifier (if not already present)

RULE PLAST-EM-25-001 (Do Not Add Modifier -25)
TRIGGER:
- Baseline contains an E/M code AND any surgical/procedural CPT
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PLAST-MULTI-PROC-51-001 (Do Not Add Modifier -51)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.surgery.multiple_procedures_performed == true
- OR baseline contains 2 or more procedural lines
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PLAST-GLOBAL-MODS-001 (Do Not Add Global Surgery Modifiers)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.surgery.stage_or_return_to_or is not null
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PLAST-ASSISTANT-001 (Do Not Add Assistant Surgeon Modifiers/Codes)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.surgery.assistant_surgeon_present == true
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PLAST-COSMETIC-001 (Do Not Add Cosmetic/Non-Covered Indicators)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.plastic_surgery.cosmetic == true
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PLAST-PROLONGED-99417-001 (Do Not Add 99417)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented == true
- AND specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes is not null
ACTION:
- No change.

QUALITY SIGNALS (Reserved)
- specialty_signals.quality.measure_context may exist, but no Plastic Surgery quality-line rules are applied in v1.0.

NON-RULES (Explicit)
- Do not infer plastic surgery CPT selection, graft/flap add-ons, implants/supplies, bundling/global package edits in v1.0.
- Do not add LT/RT unless explicitly enabled and laterality_map_by_cpt is provided.

title: Podiatry
guidelines:
SCOPE
- Apply these rules only for Podiatry.
- Use specialty_signals when present. If required signals are null/missing, do not change baseline.
- Podiatry includes E/M plus procedures (nail debridement/avulsion, callus/corn care, injections, wound care), and DME/orthotics. Coding is highly dependent on procedure specifics, laterality, number of nails/lesions, and payer coverage (notably routine foot care). This v1.0 rule set is conservative and performs deterministic normalization only, with optional laterality modifiers if explicitly enabled.

DEFINITIONS

Signals Used (optional; do not guess):
- specialty_signals.patient.is_new_patient (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.place_of_service_code (string or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_professional_billed (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_facility_billed (boolean or null)

title: Preventive Medicine
guidelines:
SCOPE
- Apply these rules only for Preventive Medicine.
- Use specialty_signals when present. If required signals are null/missing, do not change baseline.
- Preventive medicine encounters frequently involve preventive E/M, age-based code selection, immunizations, screening tests, and counseling. However, correct preventive E/M selection depends on age band, new vs established status, and whether services are preventive vs problem-oriented. This v1.0 rule set provides deterministic immunization administration reconciliation (when explicit immunization signals exist) and conservative hygiene rules; it does not re-level E/M.

DEFINITIONS

Signals Used (optional; do not guess):
- specialty_signals.patient.age_years (number or null)
- specialty_signals.patient.is_new_patient (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.place_of_service_code (string or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_professional_billed (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.encounter.is_facility_billed (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented (boolean or null)
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes (number or null)
- specialty_signals.immunization (object, optional):
  - specialty_signals.immunization.administration_events (array or null)
  - specialty_signals.immunization.administered_vaccine_cpts (array of CPT strings)
  - specialty_signals.immunization.route_family (enum: IM_SC, ORAL_NASAL, MIXED, UNKNOWN, or null)
  - specialty_signals.immunization.counseling_provided (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.immunization.funding_source (enum: state_supplied, private_stock, samples, patient_purchased, unknown, or null)
  - specialty_signals.immunization.administered_vaccine_component_counts_by_cpt (map CPT->integer, optional)

Reference Code Families (used only for reconciliation; do not guess):
- PreventiveE_M_New = {99381,99382,99383,99384,99385,99386,99387}
- PreventiveE_M_Est = {99391,99392,99393,99394,99395,99396,99397}
- OfficeE_M_New = {99202,99203,99204,99205} (reference only)
- OfficeE_M_Est = {99212,99213,99214,99215} (reference only)

Immunization admin:
- AdminTraditionalIMSC = {90471,90472}
- AdminTraditionalOralNasal = {90473,90474}
- AdminCounseling = {90460,90461}

Vaccine product lines:
- Any billable line where cpt starts with "906" or "907".

Deterministic Safety Policy
- Do not change preventive E/M code selection in v1.0 (age bands and new/est rules are often correct upstream; avoid upcoding).
- Do not add screening labs/tests (lipids, glucose, etc.) without explicit test mapping.
- Do not infer modifier -25 in v1.0.
- Immunization logic: only reconcile admin codes when specialty_signals.immunization is present and administered_vaccine_cpts is non-empty.

COMMON ADMIN LINE ATTRIBUTES (for added vaccine admin lines)
Admin Evidence Refs:
- evidence_refs = ordered unique union of evidence_refs from baseline vaccine product lines whose cpt is in administered_vaccine_cpts.
- If no matching vaccine product lines exist in baseline, do not add admin lines.

Admin ICD-10:
- If "Z23" exists in any baseline vaccine product line icd10 list, use icd10=["Z23"].
- Else icd10=[].

Provider and POS:
- Copy provider and place_of_service from the first existing admin line in baseline (any of 90471/90472/90460/90461/90473/90474).
- Else copy from the first matching baseline vaccine product line (cpt in administered_vaccine_cpts).
- If neither exists, do not add.

RULE PREV-DEDUP-001 (Exact Duplicate Merge)
TRIGGER:
- Two or more billable lines share the same (cpt/hcpcs, modifier, place_of_service, provider, sorted icd10 list).
ACTION:
- Merge duplicates into the earliest-occurring line:
  - units = sum(units)
  - evidence_refs = ordered unique union (survivor refs first)
  - remove duplicate lines

RULE PREV-UNIT-001 (Units Normalization)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line units is missing, non-integer, or < 1.
ACTION:
- Modify units:
  - if missing or < 1 => units = 1
  - if numeric but not integer => units = rounded integer

RULE PREV-MOD-WS-001 (Whitespace Modifier Cleanup)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line modifier is present but whitespace-only.
ACTION:
- Set modifier to empty string "".

RULE PREV-IMM-COUNSEL-CONVERT-001 (Convert 90471/90472 to 90460/90461 Only When Counseling Explicit)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.administered_vaccine_cpts exists AND count > 0
- AND specialty_signals.immunization.counseling_provided == true
- AND specialty_signals.immunization.route_family == "IM_SC"
ACTION:
- REMOVE all billable lines with cpt in AdminTraditionalIMSC (90471 and 90472).
- ADD 90460 with units = count(administered_vaccine_cpts).
- Compute 90461_units:
  - If administered_vaccine_component_counts_by_cpt exists:
      sum over administered_vaccine_cpts of max(component_counts[cpt] - 1, 0)
    Else:
      0
- If 90461_units > 0, ADD 90461 with units=90461_units.
- For added 90460/90461, set modifier/description/icd10/provider/POS/evidence_refs/source per “COMMON ADMIN LINE ATTRIBUTES”.

RULE PREV-IMM-TRAD-RECONCILE-001 (Align 90471/90472 Units When Counseling Explicitly False)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.administered_vaccine_cpts exists AND count > 0
- AND specialty_signals.immunization.counseling_provided == false
- AND specialty_signals.immunization.route_family == "IM_SC"
ACTION:
- Let V = count(administered_vaccine_cpts).
- If baseline contains 90471: set 90471.units = 1.
- If baseline contains 90472: set 90472.units = max(V - 1, 0).
- If baseline does not contain 90472 AND V >= 2:
  - ADD 90472 with units = V - 1 and common attributes.

RULE PREV-IMM-ORAL-NASAL-RECONCILE-001 (Oral/Nasal Admin Only When Route Family Explicit)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.administered_vaccine_cpts exists AND count > 0
- AND specialty_signals.immunization.route_family == "ORAL_NASAL"
ACTION:
- REMOVE any AdminTraditionalIMSC lines (90471/90472) if present.
- Ensure admin uses 90473 (units=1) and 90474 (units=max(V-1,0)) only if baseline already contains 90473 or 90474.
- Do not add 90473/90474 in v1.0 unless they already exist in baseline (conservative).

RULE PREV-FUNDING-SL-001 (Enforce SL for State-Supplied Vaccine Products)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.immunization.funding_source == "state_supplied"
- AND baseline contains at least one vaccine product line
ACTION:
- For each baseline vaccine product line:
  - If modifier is empty string, set modifier="SL"

RULE PREV-EM-CHANGE-001 (Do Not Re-level Preventive E/M in v1.0)
TRIGGER:
- baseline contains any PreventiveE_M code
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PREV-PROLONGED-99417-001 (Do Not Add 99417)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented == true
- AND specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes is not null
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE PREV-EM-25-001 (Do Not Add Modifier -25)
TRIGGER:
- Baseline contains preventive E/M or office E/M and procedures/labs/vaccines
ACTION:
- No change.

QUALITY SIGNALS (Reserved)
- specialty_signals.quality.measure_context may exist, but no Preventive Medicine quality-line rules are applied in v1.0.

NON-RULES (Explicit)
- Do not add screening labs/tests or counseling CPTs without explicit mapping.
- Do not change preventive E/M selection in v1.0.
- Do not infer modifiers (-25, -51, -26/TC, etc.) in v1.0.

  - specialty_signals.vascular.open_procedure (boolean or null)
  - specialty_signals.vascular.imaging_guidance_used (boolean or null)

Deterministic Safety Policy
- Do not infer vascular CPT selection (territory-based endovascular families, open bypass, fistula work) in v1.0.
- Do not infer imaging/roadmapping add-ons or supervision/interpretation codes.
- Do not infer global surgery modifiers (-58/-78/-79) in v1.0.
- Do not infer multiple procedure modifier -51 in v1.0.
- Do not infer assistant surgeon modifiers/codes in v1.0.
- Do not infer laterality modifiers (LT/RT) in v1.0.
- Do not infer E/M modifier -25 in v1.0.

RULE VASC-DEDUP-001 (Exact Duplicate Merge)
TRIGGER:
- Two or more billable lines share the same (cpt/hcpcs, modifier, place_of_service, provider, sorted icd10 list).
ACTION:
- Merge duplicates into the earliest-occurring line:
  - units = sum(units)
  - evidence_refs = ordered unique union (survivor refs first)
  - remove duplicate lines

RULE VASC-UNIT-001 (Units Normalization)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line units is missing, non-integer, or < 1.
ACTION:
- Modify units:
  - if missing or < 1 => units = 1
  - if numeric but not integer => units = rounded integer

RULE VASC-MOD-WS-001 (Whitespace Modifier Cleanup)
TRIGGER:
- Any billable line modifier is present but whitespace-only.
ACTION:
- Set modifier to empty string "".

RULE VASC-EM-25-001 (Do Not Add Modifier -25)
TRIGGER:
- Baseline contains an E/M code AND any vascular procedure CPT
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE VASC-MULTI-PROC-51-001 (Do Not Add Modifier -51)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.surgery.multiple_procedures_performed == true
- OR baseline contains 2 or more procedural lines
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE VASC-GLOBAL-MODS-001 (Do Not Add Global Surgery Modifiers)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.surgery.stage_or_return_to_or is not null
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE VASC-ASSISTANT-001 (Do Not Add Assistant Surgeon Modifiers/Codes)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.surgery.assistant_surgeon_present == true
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE VASC-LATERALITY-001 (Do Not Add LT/RT)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.procedures.laterality_map_by_cpt exists AND has entries
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE VASC-IMAGING-001 (Do Not Add Imaging Guidance or S/I Codes)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.vascular.imaging_guidance_used == true
ACTION:
- No change.

RULE VASC-PROLONGED-99417-001 (Do Not Add 99417)
TRIGGER:
- specialty_signals.documentation.time_documented == true
- AND specialty_signals.documentation.time_total_minutes is not null
ACTION:
- No change.
